newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers unchanged but undertone weak.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers unchanged but undertone weak.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were steady to soft with few enquiries seen, traders said on Wednesday.
Prices may edged lower after as cargo prices appear to be slipping, they said,
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $99-$100 by most majors with independents quoting $1-$2 per tonne lower. Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $106-$107.
Shipowners were again sidelined with most expecting prices to fall after Tuesday's dip, a seller said.
